claims.value: Novellara's letter of 3 April 1501 describes a Saint Anne cartoon
claims.statement: Pietro da Novellara's letter of 3 April 1501 to Isabella d'Este describes a cartoon of the Virgin, Child, Saint Anne and a lamb; the Mantua State Archive files it under the Saint Anne cartoon.

claims.value: The Louvre painting develops the composition described in 1501
claims.statement: That the Louvre panel derives from the 1501 cartoon (lamb motif) is a scholarly reconstruction; the London cartoon (w-burlington) shows a different composition with the infant Baptist.
